sourceComparison.csharp: Stream input values are evaluated as part of their producer before downstream continuation effects; the owning runtime scope is entered before its internal values execute. External arguments remain prerequisites.
sourceComparison.slg: Function scheduling waits for operand0 before any node, and local region scheduling applies the same rule. A stream scope now correctly retains its operand0 producer inside itself, so those rules require the scope child to run before its owning scope. Native45 emits only the consumer entry/cleanup and omits its body.
sourceComparison.decision: An owning user-block scope does not wait externally for an operand0 whose parent chain belongs to that same scope. Keep normal prerequisites for operands outside the scope, and retain internal input/role ordering when scheduling the scope body.
